mprSheetExport.h171: This parameter sets the timeout for the PDF file to appear after executing Revit’s standard "Print" or "Export" commands, as the file itself may be created with a slight delay. If for any reason the file does not appear, the plugin stops waiting after the specified time. Set a value appropriate for your environment and the speed of your printer or PDF driver: too small a value may cause false triggers, while too large a value may lead to long waits in unexpected situations
